title: Security
description: Manage security settings, permissions, and audit logs

paranoid.name: Paranoid
paranoid.description: Maximum security with minimal permissions. Only essential commands allowed.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: Balanced security with reasonable restrictions. Recommended for most users.

permissive.name: Permissive
permissive.description: Minimal restrictions with broad permissions. Use with caution.
